title: Type Narrowing
description: Use TypeScript type guards and narrowing for safer React code.

data.text: Type narrowing lets TypeScript infer more specific types within conditional blocks, making React components safer.

data.title: Type Narrowing

terms.definition: Moving from a broader type to a more specific one
Union where each member has a literal discriminant property
Ensuring all possible cases are handled

data.title: Discriminated Unions
data.text: Using literal types as discriminants makes narrowing automatic. TypeScript narrows the type based on the discriminant property.

data.title: Narrowing in React
items: Use status enums for async states
Type the status property as a literal union
Use custom guards for external data

data.caption: TypeScript narrowing flow through conditional rendering
data.definition:
flowchart TD
    A[AsyncState<T>] --> B{status === 'loading'?}
    B -->|Yes| C[TypeScript: data is undefined]
    B -->|No| D{status === 'error'?}
    D -->|Yes| E[TypeScript: error is defined]
    D -->|No| F[TypeScript: status is 'success', data is T]
    F --> G[Render data safely]

data.title: Exercise: Narrow a Form State
data.description: Create a discriminated union for form submission states.
steps: Define FormState with idle, submitting, success, and error
Create a component that narrows on status
Type the success data and error message appropriately
Add an exhaustive check with never
data.expectedOutcome: A form component with fully narrowed types for each state.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use literal types for status fields
Create custom type guards with predicate functions
data.takeaway: Type narrowing makes conditional rendering in React safer and more explicit.
